youtubeTitle: Gospel and Soul Health Session 19 - Dr Bruce Wauchope
chapter: Chapter 3 Session 6 - The Removal of the Power of Satan; The Water Flowing from Christ's Side; The Blood of Christ - Fulfilling Adoption
topic: Satan disarmed; water and blood of adoption
summary: After recapping how Christ fulfilled and broke the law of sin and death, removed sin forever and emptied Hades, Wauchope turns to the power of Satan. Through death Jesus destroyed the one who held the power of death and freed those enslaved by fear of death, so no one can bring a charge against God's elect. When the spear pierced Christ's side, water flowed out like Ezekiel's temple river, 'baptising the universe' with the cleaned-up life of the incarnate Son. The blood is not a magical substance or an offering humanity gives upward. God gives it downward, and it is the life of the One in whom Father, Word and Spirit, humanity and our cleansed darkness are made 'at-one'. That blood has broken the earthly law and, in the heavenly temple, fulfils the heavenly law of adoption, so that Jesus, the Mercy Seat and meeting place of created and uncreated, carries us into Sonship.
keyPoints: Recap: Jesus fulfilled the law by loving the Father wholly; we died with Him so death has no second bite; the law was broken by killing the Sinless One; sins are removed forever; He holds the keys of Hades and death.
The Son was manifested to destroy the works of the devil: our darkness, aloneness, fear, guilt, freezing and the lies built into our inner structures (1 John 3:8).
Through death Jesus destroyed him who had the power of death and released those who were held in lifelong bondage by fear of death (Hebrews 2:14-15).
The powers 'shot themselves in the foot', and Father, Son and Spirit did it for petty, violent humans whom they love. To the powers that is nauseating; to us it is grace.
Who shall bring a charge against God's elect? There is no longer any basis for accusation, and the fitting response is thanksgiving and worship.
Jesus is the only meeting place of God and humanity: the Mercy Seat, the propitiation, the tabernacling of God with us.
The water from His pierced side is like the water flowing from under Ezekiel's temple, ever deeper and wider. The cleaned-up life of the incarnate Son pours out and 'baptises the universe'.
Leviticus 17: 'I have given it to you.' Blood comes down from God, not up from us. Animal sacrifices met our fallen conscience where it was and pointed toward the day we would die in Him.
Treating 'the blood' as a magical force ('pleading the blood', blood rings) is pagan, constructionist thinking. The blood is the life and relationship of the Person.

1 John 5: Father, Word and Spirit are one in heaven, and Spirit, water and blood are one on earth. The blood flowing from Jesus is human blood and the blood of God, carrying the at-one-ment of the Trinity, humanity and our cleansed darkness.

There are two temples. The earthly temple deals with the Fall, sin and Mosaic law, which Christ has already crushed. In the heavenly temple His blood fulfils the heavenly law of adoption and Sonship, the New Covenant.

Don't build theology from below, inside the law of sin and death. Christ has lifted us into the heavenly. Torrance, drawing on Athanasius, says human existence is now anchored and secured in Christ's crucified and risen being, whether people believe it or not.

keyTerms.definition: Our darkness, aloneness, fear, locked guilt, freezing and false inner structures, which Christ came to destroy.
The cleaned-up life of the incarnate Son flowing out into creation like Ezekiel's river, 'baptising the universe'.
Jesus Himself as the meeting place of the uncreated God and created humanity.
The union, in Christ's person and blood, of Father, Word, Spirit, humanity and our cleansed darkness.
The principle that God gives the blood to us; we do not offer it to appease God.
The law of Sonship fulfilled by Christ's blood in the heavenly temple: 'you will be my sons and daughters'.
Wauchope's reading of John 1:12: we are made sons and daughters out of Christ's own being.

quotes: That water from His side is baptizing the universe.
I have given it to you; you do not give it to Me. It's down and not up.
We don't see the blood as magic. You stay with the Person.
At the core of it is Sonship.

caseStudy.title: Pleading the blood out of fear
caseStudy.scenario: Priya, 29, was taught to 'plead the blood of Jesus' over her house, car and family every morning to keep evil away. If she forgets, she becomes anxious that something bad will happen and blames herself when it does. She feels God's protection depends on her saying the words correctly. Her anxiety is growing and she struggles to sleep.
caseStudy.analysis: Wauchope would see magical, constructionist thinking here: the blood treated as a force we wield upward or outward rather than the life of the Person given down to us. Christ has already destroyed the one with the power of death and freed people from fear of death. His blood fulfils adoption: Priya is a daughter held in the Mercy Seat, not a ritual technician. Her anxiety fits the bondage to fear that Hebrews 2 says Christ came to end.
pathway: Gently notice the fear behind the ritual and name it to Father, Son and Spirit.
Replace formula prayers with relational ones: 'Dad, thank you that I'm already Yours and held in Jesus.'
Study Hebrews 2:14-15 and 1 John 5:11 on life given in the Son.
Practise skipping the formula once while staying in conversation with Jesus, and notice that she is still held.
If anxiety and sleeplessness persist, talk with a GP or counsellor, since compulsive patterns can benefit from professional support.

practices.name: Thank-you litany
practices.how: Slowly thank the Father, Son and Spirit for each freedom: law broken, sins removed, death defeated, no accusation, and adoption fulfilled.

practices.name: River meditation
practices.how: Read Ezekiel 47:1-5 and picture the life from Christ's side rising around you, ankle-, knee- and waist-deep, washing your own darkness.

practices.name: Down, not up
practices.how: When you catch yourself trying to earn God's favour, pause and say, 'You gave this to me; I receive.'

reflection: Where have you treated spiritual words or symbols as magic rather than as relationship with a Person?
How does knowing Christ's blood fulfils adoption, not just payment, change how you see yourself?
What fear of death or loss still holds you in bondage?

quiz.q: According to Leviticus 17 as Wauchope reads it, which direction does the blood flow?
options: Down: God gives it to us
Up: we offer it to appease God
quiz.explain: 'I have given it to you': it comes down, not up.

quiz.q: What does Christ's blood fulfil in the heavenly temple?
options: The law of sin and death
The heavenly law of adoption and Sonship
quiz.explain: The heavenly temple is about Sonship; the earthly law was already broken.

quiz.q: What does Wauchope say about the water flowing from Christ's side?
options: It was merely a medical sign of death
It is like Ezekiel's temple river, baptising the universe with Christ's cleaned-up life
quiz.explain: He links John 19:34 with Ezekiel 47's ever-widening river.
